results.note: Historia translationis S. Augustini Anglorum by Goscelin - No English translation found in searches of academic databases, medieval source inventories, or scholarly editions.

Vita S. Eadgitae included in Rosalind C. Love's 2004 Oxford Medieval Texts edition 'Goscelin of Saint-Bertin: The Hagiography of the Female Saints of Ely' with full Latin text and English translation.

Vita S. Swithuni - This work has been attributed to Goscelin for centuries but modern scholarship (Michael Lapidge) has disproven this attribution. The Vita S. Swithuni in PL 155 may not actually be by Goscelinus.

Vita S. Wereburgae included in Rosalind C. Love's 2004 Oxford Medieval Texts edition 'Goscelin of Saint-Bertin: The Hagiography of the Female Saints of Ely' with full Latin text and English translation.
Vita S. Yvonis by Goscelin - Searched multiple databases and medieval translation inventories; no English translation found. Attribution to Goscelin is also disputed by scholars.
Ludovicus Pius - Privilegium - Documented in MGH Diplomata but no complete English translation found in searches of medieval translation resources.
Ludovicus Pius - Diplomata ecclesiastica - While these documents are catalogued in MGH and PL, no specific English translation of this collection found in searches.
Ludovicus Pius - Epistolae - Medieval correspondence; no complete English translation found despite searches of NPNF, ACW, and Fordham Medieval Sourcebook.
Ludovicus Pius - Diploma concessum Hettoni Basileensi - Brief diplomatic document (451 words); no English translation found.
Ludovicus Pius - Appendix - Brief work (938 words); no English translation found in searches.
Anselmus Laudunensis - Enarrationes in Apocalypsin - Extensive biblical commentary (37,718 words); exists only in Latin in Patrologia Latina and scholarly databases; no English translation found.
Anselmus Laudunensis - Enarrationes in Cantica canticorum - Biblical commentary (17,578 words); no English translation found despite searches of patristic translation series.
Anselmus Laudunensis - Ennarrationes in Matthaeum - Extensive biblical commentary (113,689 words); exists only in Latin at BnF and other manuscript repositories; no English translation found.
Anselmus Laudunensis - Epistola - Brief letter (2,029 words); no English translation found.

Auctor incertus (Prosper Aquitanus?) - Carmen de providentia divina - English translation by Michael P. McHugh published by Catholic University of America Press 1964-1965 (Patristic Studies vol. 98) with Latin and English on facing pages. Note: authorship attribution to Prosper is disputed.
Auctor incertus (Prosper Aquitanus?) - Confessio - Work of uncertain attribution (marked incertus); no English translation found in academic databases.

Auctor incertus (Prosper Aquitanus?) - De vocatione omnium gentium - English translation by P. De Letter published by Newman Press 1952 in Ancient Christian Writers series (vol. 14, 234 pages). Standard patristic translation with introduction and extensive notes.
Auctor incertus (Prosper Aquitanus?) - Poema conjugis ad uxorem - Brief work (685 words); no English translation found despite searches.
Benedictinus anonymus - De conscientia - Anonymous Benedictine work; no English translation found in searches of medieval translation inventories or patristic databases.
Benedictinus anonymus - De poenitentia et tentationibus religiosorum - Anonymous monastic work (15,428 words); no English translation found.
Benedictinus anonymus - De stabilitate animae - Anonymous monastic work (6,618 words); no English translation found despite searches.
Benedictinus anonymus - Dialogus de esu volatilium - Anonymous dialogue on eating birds (5,739 words); no English translation found.
Bonifacius Moguntinus - Vita - English translations exist including Edward Kylie's 1911 edition and references to other modern scholarly translations in medieval studies sources.

Bonifacius Moguntinus - Epistolae - English translations of St. Boniface's letters exist including Edward Kylie's 1911 edition 'English correspondence of Saint Boniface' and other scholarly publications.
Bonifacius Moguntinus - Juramentum - Very brief work (232 words); no specific English translation found in searches despite availability of translations of other Boniface materials.
Bonifacius Moguntinus - Sermones - Collection of sermons (11,385 words); no specific English translation found despite searches of patristic translation series.
Braulio Caesaraugustanus - Acta de martyribus Caesaraugustanis - Brief work (1,422 words); no English translation found despite searches of medieval martyrology sources.
Braulio Caesaraugustanus - Epistolae - Medieval letters (19,542 words); Brepols published critical Latin edition (2018) but no English translation found in searches.
Braulio Caesaraugustanus - Hymnus - Brief hymn (345 words); no English translation found.
Braulio Caesaraugustanus - Vita S. Aemiliani - Saint's life (4,866 words); no English translation found despite searches of medieval hagiography resources.

Guigo I prior Carthusiae - Consuetudines - Complete English translation by Fr. Ugo-Maria Ginex (2018) freely available on Internet Archive under CC-BY-NC-ND 4.0 license; translator used this as his Rule of Life since 1995.
Guigo I prior Carthusiae - Epistolae - Brief letters (2,969 words); no English translation found in searches despite Guigo's other works being translated.

Guigo I prior Carthusiae - Meditationes - Two English translations exist: (1) J. J. Jolin translation (1951, Marquette University Press); (2) A. Gordon Mursell translation (1995, Cistercian Publications, Cistercian Studies Series vol. 155, considered superior).

Guigo I prior Carthusiae - Vita S. Hugonis Gratianopolitani - Life of Saint Hugh of Grenoble (8,096 words); no English translation found despite searches of medieval hagiography and Carthusian studies resources.
Guitmundus Aversanus - Confessio - Brief work (2,482 words); no English translation found.

Guitmundus Aversanus - De corporis et sanguinis Christi veritate in Eucharistia - Major eucharistic treatise (27,326 words); widely cited in scholarly literature but no complete English translation found despite searches of theological and patristic translation series.
Guitmundus Aversanus - Epistola ad Erfastum - Letter work (0 words recorded); no English translation found.
Guitmundus Aversanus - Oratio ad Guillelmum I Anglorum - Prayer/oration to William I of England (0 words recorded); no English translation found.

Hariulfus Aldenburgensis - Chronicon Centulense - Major chronicle of Saint-Riquier abbey (56,393 words); French translation by Le Ver and Prarond published 1899; no English translation found in searches.
Hariulfus Aldenburgensis - Compendium vitae Arnulfi - Brief vita (1,127 words); no English translation found.
Hariulfus Aldenburgensis - Vita S. Arnulfi - Life of Saint Arnulf (23,600 words); no English translation found in searches of medieval hagiography resources.
Hariulfus Aldenburgensis - Vita S. Madelgisili - Life of Saint Madelgisilus (3,426 words); no English translation found.
